name: .458 Cal-250gr Stone Hammer®
note: Recommended use: Big Game Hunting. The product page also says: "This 250gr Stone Hammer™ was designed specifically for the 45-70 Gov. This pure copper bullet will work well in the old trap door models as well as the lever action and modern rifles. With the big 1/4″ hollow point it will be a hard hitting performer with excellent velocity for hunting big game."
